title: VMware security advisory (AV26-1203)
description: As of November 24, 2026, VMware is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
VMware Cloud Foundation / VMware vSphere Foundation - vCenter
	9.1.x.x versions prior to 9.1.2
9.0.x.x versions prior to 9.0.2.0300

VMware vCenter
	8.0 versions prior to 8.0 U3m
Version 7.0

VMware Cloud Foundation vCenter
	5.x versions prior to 5.2.5

VMware Telco Cloud Platform vCenter
	Versions 3.0, 4.x, 5.0.x, 5.1.x and 5.2

VMware Telco Cloud Infrastructure vCenter
	Version 3.0
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
